title: Sequin Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a dazzling entrance in this Sequin Chiffon Mother of the Bride Dress! Featuring elegant ruffle sleeves, shimmering sequins, and a flowing chiffon silhouette, this dress exudes timeless sophistication. Perfect for weddings, galas, or any special occasion where you want to shine!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
